subject: Supersede prior Alpha3 deployment-drift alert: runtime commit now landed
body: Supersedes the 02:38Z Agent01 head-drift alert. GitHub main advanced during this research session to 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70 (Make Fold7 hinge authority explicit and ordered). Revalidation confirms Fold7AngleAuthority is now in app/**, FoldOverlayService owns the full-build HingeAngleSource and DuoApp reads service authoritative angle in the full build. The sensor-forensics conclusion is unchanged: there is still no Shizuku-side direct SensorManager listener, and FoldInteractive should remain the precise producer pending physical UID-2000 private-sensor proof.
